children: NCS Multistage Holdings Inc. (NCSM) filed a Form 8K - Changes in Company Control - with the U.S Securities and Exchange Commission on September 01, 2026.
The information set forth under the Introductory Note and Items 2.01 and 5.02 of this Current Report on Form 8-K is incorporated by reference into this Item 5.01.
As a result of the completion of the Merger, a change in control of the Company occurred, and the Company became a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent.
The full text of this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1692427/000119312526377638/d534761d8k.htm
Any exhibits and associated documents for this SEC filing can be retrieved at: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1692427/000119312526377638/0001193125-26-377638-index.htm
Public companies must file a Form 8-K, or current report, with the SEC generally within four days of any event that could materially affect a company's financial position or the value of its shares.
